title: MDS Legendary 40th edition — official live page (stage data)
claims: The 40th MDS Legendary ran from 3 to 13 April 2026.
Stage 1 on 5 April 2026: 35 km, 285 m of gain, start 07:00, maximum arrival time 17:00.
Stage 2 on 6 April 2026: 40.5 km, 486 m of gain, start 06:00, maximum arrival time 17:35.
Stage 3 on 7 April 2026: 29.1 km, 413 m of gain, maximum arrival time 15:20; the page does not print a start time.
Stage 4 on 8 and 9 April 2026: 100 km, 721 m of gain, start 05:00 or 07:00, maximum arrival time 21:00 on the following day.
Stage 5 on 10 April 2026: 42.2 km, 424 m of gain, start 06:30, maximum arrival time 18:35.
Stage 6 on 11 April 2026: 23.2 km, 238 m of gain, maximum arrival time 13:10; the page does not print a start time.
The six official stage distances sum to 270.0 km and the six official stage gains sum to 2,567 m.

verification.checkedVia: 桌面 UA 直连抓取 https://marathondessables.com/en/live/live-mds-legendary-40th-edition，并解析页面内嵌的 Nuxt 数据块（STAGE 1–6 的日期、距离、爬升、出发与最晚到达）
verification.note: 2026-11-08 读取。页面默认展示 Stage 1，其余赛段数据在同一页面的内嵌数据中。Stage 3 与 Stage 6 的出发时间字段为空，只给最晚到达时间；本页不推算缺失的出发时间。Stage 4 的出发时间原文为「5:00 or 7:00 AM」，最晚到达为「9:00 PM (D+1)」。
